title: Sign in and access the stock search home screen
description: This verifies that a shopper can log in successfully and reach the home search experience used for stock lookups.
category: Ticker Search and Stock Detail View

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the home search screen is displayed
Verify access to the stock lookup flow is available

title: Open a stock detail view from a valid ticker
description: This verifies that a user can enter a valid ticker and reach the detail screen with market summary data and the 1-day intra-day chart.
category: Ticker Search and Stock Detail View

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Fill in the ticker field with AAPL
Submit the stock search
Verify the stock detail screen is displayed
Verify market summary data and the 1-day intra-day chart are displayed

title: Sign in and access protected pages
description: This test verifies that a user can sign in successfully and then open protected pages that require an authenticated session.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to the inventory page
Verify the inventory page is accessible
Click the link to the backup and restore page
Verify the backup and restore page is accessible

title: Stay signed in after returning to login
description: This test verifies that an authenticated user keeps their session when revisiting the login screen and can still access protected pages.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /login
Click the link to the inventory page
Verify the inventory page is accessible

title: Log in and open the inventory page
description: This verifies that an authenticated user can access the inventory management area and see loaded product records.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open inventory management
Verify the inventory page is displayed
Verify product records are loaded

title: Reject invalid login credentials
description: This test verifies that entering invalid credentials keeps the user on the login screen and shows a login error.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with invalid-user
Fill in the password field with invalid-password
Submit the login form
Verify a login error is visible
Verify the user remains on the login screen

title: Block inventory access without signing in
description: This verifies that an unauthenticated visitor cannot open the inventory page and is denied access or redirected to sign in.

steps.description: Navigate to /inventory
Verify access to the inventory page is denied
Verify a sign-in or authorization denial state is displayed

title: Require authentication for protected pages
description: This test verifies that an unauthenticated user cannot open protected pages and is denied access.

steps.description: Navigate to /inventory
Verify access to the inventory page is denied
Navigate to /backup-restore
Verify access to the backup and restore page is denied

title: Reject incomplete login submission
description: This test verifies that missing credentials prevent sign-in and produce inline validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Submit the login form without entering credentials
Verify a login validation error is visible
Verify the user remains on the login screen

title: Log in and open the backup and restore page

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open backup and restore
Verify the backup and restore interface is displayed
Verify sync status or action controls are visible

title: Sign in and open backup restore tools
description: This test verifies that an authenticated user can sign in and reach the backup and restore screen for sync actions.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to the backup and restore page
Verify the backup and restore page is accessible

title: Block backup and restore access without signing in
description: This verifies that an unauthenticated visitor cannot open the backup and restore page and is denied access.

steps.description: Navigate to /backup-restore
Verify access to the backup and restore page is denied
Verify a sign-in or authorization denial state is displayed

title: Reject an empty stock search
description: This verifies that submitting an empty ticker keeps the user on the home screen and shows validation feedback.
category: Ticker Search and Stock Detail View

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Leave the ticker field empty
Submit the stock search
Verify no stock detail screen is opened
Verify ticker validation feedback is visible

title: Reject an invalid numeric ticker
description: This verifies that invalid numeric-only input is rejected and cannot be submitted as a stock lookup.
category: Ticker Search and Stock Detail View

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Fill in the ticker field with 123
Attempt to submit the stock search
Verify the ticker input rejects the invalid value
Verify no stock detail screen is opened

title: Sync local data from the backup and restore screen

Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open backup and restore
Start synchronization
Verify synchronization progress or completion status is visible
Verify a successful sync confirmation is visible
